list: The official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18. Names, descriptions and grades match the frozen kit list, checked against Exophase and PSNProfiles on launch day. Guide text is written for this guide; sources are listed per trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned. There is nothing extra to do for it beyond finishing everything else, so treat the roadmap as the plan and tick trophies off as you go.
steps: Earn all 54 other trophies
The platinum pops automatically once the last one lands

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first story trophy most players will earn. Play through the opening as the game directs it; no side work is needed. If you are just starting, this is your confirmation that the tracker is working.
steps: Start a new game
Complete the Gone Fishing mission

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full. Story chapters unlock in order, so keep playing the main missions until the chapter-end screen appears. There is no way to skip ahead to it.
steps: Play the Chapter 1 main missions in order
Finish the final mission of the chapter

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 in full. Like the other chapter trophies it comes from playing the main missions in order, so keep following the story thread until the chapter closes.
steps: Play the Chapter 2 main missions in order
Finish the final mission of the chapter

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full. The chapter trophies are pure story progress: play the main missions in the order the game gives them and this pops at the end of the chapter.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 main missions in order
Finish the final mission of the chapter

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 in full. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so by the time it pops you are one step from the gold story trophy. Keep playing the main missions in order.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 main missions in order
Finish the final mission of the chapter

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. This is a gold trophy and the last story beat; it unlocks when the credits roll after the final mission. Expect it only after Chapters 1 to 4 are done, so there is no shortcut to it.
steps: Complete Chapters 1 to 4
Play the final mission through to the end

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission. It is a named story mission, so it appears in the main mission flow; play it when the game offers it and finish it to earn the trophy.
steps: Reach the Breakfast Run mission in the story
Complete it

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission. It is a named story mission in the main flow; take it on when it unlocks and see it through to the end.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist mission in the story
Complete it

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission. It is a named story mission, so it comes up in the main mission flow; play it when offered and finish it.
steps: Reach the Child's Play mission in the story
Complete it

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission. A named story mission in the main flow; play it when the game offers it and finish it to earn the trophy.
steps: Reach the Headliners mission in the story
Complete it

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission. It is a named story mission at the airport; take it on when it unlocks in the main flow and see it through.
steps: Reach the VCIA Takedown mission in the story
Complete it

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission. A named story mission in the main flow; play it when offered and finish it.
steps: Reach the Operation Savage Glory mission in the story
Complete it

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion. The official description gives the goal and the PSN counter tracks it out of 100. Guide sites report the checklist runs to about 35 tasks plus most of the 80 challenges, but that breakdown is reported, not verified on real hardware, so treat it as a guide rather than a promise. Work through the story, side strands, activities and collectibles and watch the counter climb.
steps: Finish the story
Complete side-mission strands, activities and collectibles
Check the in-game 100% checklist as you go

sources.label: Keengamer — GTA 6 trophy guide / platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the game's jump and trick moments; the counter tracks them out of 250. Spread them across free roam rather than grinding one spot, and keep an eye on the counter so you know when you are close.
steps: Attempt stunts in free roam — jumps and trick driving
Vary the spots you use so new stunts keep registering
Keep going until the counter reaches 250

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — nine types in total. The point is breadth, not mastery: sample every activity the game offers at least once. If one type is still missing, the activity menu is the place to look for what you have not tried.
steps: Open the activities list and note the types you have not tried
Try each remaining type at least once
The trophy pops once all nine types are sampled

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a precision trophy: gold in every challenge, not just a pass. Practise each range until the gold standard is comfortable, then clear them one by one.
steps: Visit a shooting range and try each challenge
Repeat a challenge until you earn its gold medal
Gold-medal all 42 challenges

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 wins in total. Each location needs its own win, so a single favourite track is not enough. Learn each course, then win them in turn.
steps: Find the Top Fun Drone Race locations
Win the race at each location
Repeat until all 14 locations are won

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Different races count, so repeating the same one does not move the counter. Work through the race list and tick off new ones until 20 are won.
steps: Enter races you have not won before
Win each one — repeats of a won race do not count
Keep going until 20 different races are won

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so bring your best catch rather than your first. The official description does not name the spot, so follow the fishing challenge prompts in game.
steps: Find a fishing challenge against Cal
Out-fish Cal in the challenge

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any arcade game counts — pick one you enjoy and play it through to the end. No score target is named, just completion.
steps: Find an arcade machine
Play an arcade game through to its end

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is a side character; follow his mission strand to its end. The strand unlocks through play, so keep an eye out for Andy's missions as you explore Leonida.
steps: Find Andy's missions and work through his strand
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton is a side character; follow his mission strand to its end. His missions unlock through play, so watch for them as you move around Leonida.
steps: Find Kenton's missions and work through his strand
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy is a side character; follow his mission strand to its end. His missions unlock through play, so keep an eye out for them while exploring.
steps: Find Billy's missions and work through his strand
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Strangers hand out their own mission chains; finish eight full strands. Explore the map and talk to the strangers you meet — the counter tracks 0/8.
steps: Meet strangers across Leonida and take their missions
Finish a full strand for each stranger
Complete 8 strands in total

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy is a side character; follow his mission strand to its end. His missions unlock through play, so watch for them as you explore Leonida.
steps: Find Randy's missions and work through his strand
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone is a side character; follow his mission strand to its end. His missions unlock through play, so keep an eye out for them while exploring.
steps: Find Tyrone's missions and work through his strand
Complete his final mission

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots. This is the one trophy guide sites flag as possibly missable: PowerPyx via GTABase report that the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia stops counting once the chapter ends, and that there is no mission replay or New Game Plus. That is reported, not verified on real hardware, so treat it as a warning, not a certainty: meditate at every spot you find, starting in Chapter 1, and do not leave a spot for later if you can do it now.
steps: Meditate at every meditation spot you find, from Chapter 1 onward
Do not skip the Chapter 1 balcony spot — guides report it may become unavailable
Keep going until the counter reaches 18/18

sources.label: Outputlag — GTA 6 trophy list (missable report, via PowerPyx / GTABase)
Keengamer — GTA 6 trophy guide / platinum roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand is about hunting; follow it until the unique animal is taken. The official description does not name the animal or the location, so follow Bret's missions in game rather than guessing a spot.
steps: Find Bret's missions and work through his strand
Hunt the unique animal his missions point to

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered as collectibles; a set is complete when every card in it is found. The counter tracks sets, 0/3, so keep collecting until three sets are done.
steps: Pick up collectible cards as you explore
Finish every card in a set to complete it
Complete 3 sets in total

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are spread across Leonida; use each one you pass. The counter tracks 0/100, so this is a long-haul collectible best done as you travel rather than in one sitting.
steps: Use a WAiNK spot whenever you pass one
Cover new areas so fresh locations keep appearing
Keep going until the counter reaches 100

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges cover many kinds of play; the counter tracks 0/50. Any 50 count, so pick the ones that suit how you play and let the total build up over time.
steps: Open the challenges list and pick ones that suit your play
Complete challenges as you play
Keep going until 50 are done

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears. The partner requirement is the tricky part — make sure they are alongside before the heat rises.
steps: Have your partner with you
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars
Break line of sight and stay hidden until it clears

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Three robberies in a row, partner present, wanted level never dropping. Plan a route between three nearby shops and move fast between them.
steps: Have your partner with you
Pick three shops close together
Rob all three in a row without losing the wanted level

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Any new vehicle you find counts toward 0/100. Drive a wide variety and explore new areas so fresh models keep appearing — the same model twice does not add to the count.
steps: Drive and encounter vehicles you have not found before
Explore new areas for fresh models
Keep going until the counter reaches 100

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-aim mode; trigger it with several enemies in view and drop five before it ends. Pick a busy fight and line the targets up first.
steps: Find a fight with at least 5 enemies in view
Trigger Combat Focus
Take down 5 enemies before it ends

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. VCIA is the airport; leave it in a way the game does not schedule — take a plane out yourself rather than following a scripted exit. The official description is deliberately vague, so experiment at the airport and watch for the pop.
steps: Go to VCIA, the airport
Take a plane and leave on your own terms, outside a scripted departure

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos. Rhinos are the tanks; the description hints at spending time in one under fire. Get into a Rhino and survive the heat it draws — the exact trigger is not spelled out in the official text, so expect it to pop during heavy tank play.
steps: Get into a Rhino tank
Stay in it through a heavy fight

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. Plan the entry, move slowly, and leave before anyone notices.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry
Take the goods without triggering detection
Leave clean

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Five vault robberies, each followed by a clean escape. The counter tracks 0/5. Treat each one as its own job: rob, then get clear before it counts.
steps: Rob a bank vault
Escape cleanly after each robbery
Repeat until 5 vaults are robbed and escaped from

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop a truck, take its cargo and get away. Trucks roam the roads, so watch for one, hit it fast and break away before the response arrives.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road
Stop it and take its cargo
Escape before the response catches you

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas. The counter tracks explored regions out of 52. Drive and walk into every corner of the map; the last few areas are usually the small or out-of-the-way ones.
steps: Travel across Leonida, entering new areas
Check the map for unexplored corners
Keep going until all 52 areas are explored

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — 9 gangs. Each gang's operation counts once, so you need all nine. The counter tracks 0/9; work through the gangs one at a time.
steps: Find an illegal operation belonging to a gang
Rob it
Repeat for all 9 gangs

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. The official description names the place but not the bar, so look for a drinks spot along the beachfront.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach
Find a drinks spot with a view and enjoy a cocktail there

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive through a showroom's frontage rather than using the door. Pick a showroom, build speed, and go straight through the glass.
steps: Take a vehicle into a showroom
Smash out through the frontage instead of the exit

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a frame at the named bowling alley and follow through on the throw. The location is named in the description, so head there and bowl.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley
Bowl a frame and follow through on the throw

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. The official description gives no concrete action, so this is one to discover in play — it is reported as a hidden trophy tied to a partnership moment. Follow partner activities and watch for the pop; no specific location is stated in the official description.
steps: Play partner activities together
Watch for the trophy to pop during a partnership moment

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). The counter tracks 0/500, so this is about volume: hundreds of choices across the game. Keep playing and making decisions; the total builds over a full playthrough.
steps: Keep playing and making choices as they come
The counter climbs toward 500 over a full playthrough

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The description hints at succeeding on a second attempt at something that failed once. If an activity or event fails, try it again right away rather than moving on.
steps: Attempt an activity or event
If it fails, try it again immediately and succeed on the second attempt

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? A hidden trophy for a strange encounter — the description is a reaction, not an instruction. Explore odd corners of Leonida and expect this to pop when something unusual happens. No specific location is stated in the official description.
steps: Explore unusual or out-of-the-way places in Leonida
Trigger the strange encounter the trophy is tied to

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A drive-by using a melee weapon — knock targets down from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Line up a slow pass and swing as you go by.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a vehicle
Drive slowly past targets and strike with the melee weapon from the vehicle

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are laundered through contacts; the counter tracks dollars up to $250,000. Keep feeding bills through your contacts over the course of play.
steps: Collect Marked Bills
Launder them through your contacts
Keep going until $250,000 is laundered

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Any spending counts toward the $100,000 total. Buy gear, clothes and supplies as you play and the counter climbs on its own.
steps: Spend money in shops as you play
Any shop spending counts toward the $100,000 total

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 in total. Buy every garage the game offers. The counter tracks 0/8; garages cost money, so save up and buy them as they appear.
steps: Save money for property purchases
Buy each garage property as it becomes available
Own all 8 garages

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register vehicles you own or find through the Scooter Bros app until the counter hits 10. Any 10 vehicles count.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app
Register vehicles through it until 10 are registered
